name: CDN Cache Coherence (CloudFront Platinum-Artifact Staleness Defense)
description: Eliminate the toxic primitive at the CloudFront edge layer where platinum artifact emits refresh on S3 but CDN max-age holds prior object cached — producing 'stale data displays' symptom that masquerades as FE bug or DS emit failure. Empirically anchored 2026-05-14 ~19:4XZ via RD 0.4.2 investigation: served JSON `generated_at: 2026-05-14T00:27:07Z + histogram={}` empty placeholder while S3 source had `generated_at: 2026-05-14T19:03:51Z + 22-bin populated histogram`; CloudFront `x-cache: Hit from cloudfront, age=64908s` ≈ 18hr stale. FE code correct (render-gate falls to placeholder on empty histogram as designed); root cause = CDN cache layer not refreshed post gold-chain platinum emit. Sister class to ADHC_FECACHE_COHERENCE (FE cache poisoning) + ADHC_LEDGEH (L@E origin error envelope) — same 3-layer cache architecture (FE / CDN / origin); each layer needs structural-discipline defense. CTO lean: Option 2 (cache header reduction via Lambda@Edge origin-response sets `Cache-Control: max-age=60, must-revalidate`) — structural prevention vs operational invalidation discipline. Option 1 (dispatch.sh post-chain CF invalidation) ships as immediate interim per AE 0.6.1 concurrent side-task. Fifth ADHC defense-in-depth project, complementing the 4-project corpus to cover all 3 cache layers + 2 wire boundaries (L@E error + producer/consumer phantom + bronze-pmv hybrid).

source_brief: 2026-05-14 ~19:4XZ RD 0.4.2 NNA L0 Track A investigation INVERSION: initial framing 'FE display bug' surfaced as CloudFront cache staleness (age=64908s ≈ 18hr) holding stale platinum artifact. Empirical: served `partner_analytics_quarterly.json#views.nna.quarterly.geo.firm_wide.histogram` = {} while S3 source had 22-bin populated histogram from 19:03Z chain emit. FE render-gate correctly falls to placeholder on empty histogram; FE code path verified. CTO RECP framing identifies CDN edge layer as 2nd of 3 cache layers needing defense-in-depth (sister to ADHC_FECACHE_COHERENCE which addressed Layer 1 FE React Query cache poisoning). Three structural fix options enumerated: (1) dispatch.sh post-chain CF invalidation (~immediate; AE 0.6.1 lane); (2) CloudFront cache headers `must-revalidate` + short `max-age` via Lambda@Edge origin-response (structural; AE 0.7 lane; CTO LEAN); (3) manual invalidation hook (operational). CTO lean Option 2 per structural-prevention principle (eliminates 'forgot-to-invalidate' failure class) + sister to React Query buster v1→v2 pattern + sister to phantom-consumer-marker-pattern 'before assuming cache state, verify freshness wire-protocol' principle.
